basis: The observed campaign used float32 inputs with candidate FP16 input downcasts.
The observed correctness gate used atol=0.01 and rtol=0.01 on fixed contiguous 4096x4096 positive inputs.
The candidate explicitly downcasts both float32 inputs to float16, which strict-fp32-v1 forbids.
The candidate asserts one fixed 4096x4096 shape and contiguous layouts, so it cannot pass the strict profile's required non-tile-aligned, rectangular, and transposed holdout cases.
Historical 1% tolerance evidence is not strict-FP32 correctness evidence.

notes: This reassessment does not claim an unobserved H100 timing result.
campaign.py is blocked until the trusted evaluator boundary is implemented; only afterward can an external H100 run write observed profile_evidence.json.
